label: AbiC system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an abiC-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder AbiC__AbiC profile and exemplified by the Lactococcus lactis subsp. lactis ME2 pTN20 determinant whose abiC structural gene confers Prf abortive resistance to small isometric-headed phage p2, reducing plaquing, plaque size, and burst size while killing most infected Prf-positive cells.
observations: AbiC branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiC genes, AbiC proteins, the pTN20 plasmid, the DefenseFinder AbiC__AbiC HMM profile, source database rows naming one AbiC locus, individual lactococcal phage host-range outcomes, unresolved AbiC triggers or cell-death routes, and generic abortive infection systems.
